values.name: Allowance
values.description: Code specifying an allowance.

values.name: Total other
values.description: The total for items other than those primarily reported upon in the message.

values.name: Charge
values.description: Code specifying a charge.

values.name: Allowance per call off
values.description: Code specifying a call off allowance.

values.name: Charge per call off
values.description: Code specifying a charge per call off.

values.name: Allowance message
values.description: Allowance is related to the entire message.

values.name: Allowance line items
values.description: Allowance is related to all line items in a message as a default allowance. It may be overridden per line item.

values.name: Line item allowance
values.description: Allowance is related to a line item. It can override a default allowance.

values.name: Adjustment
values.description: Code specifying that the allowance or charge is due to an adjustment.

values.name: Charge message
values.description: Charge is related to the entire message.

values.name: Charge line items
values.description: Charge is related to all line items in a message as a default charge. It may be overridden per line item.

values.name: Line item charge
values.description: Charge is related to a line item. It can override a default charge.

values.name: No allowance or charge
values.description: No increases or reduction in price (list or stated) are included.

values.name: About
values.description: To be construed as allowing a difference not exceeding 10 % more or 10 % less than the amount which it refers.

values.name: Minus (percentage)
values.description: The lesser value expressed in percentage.

values.name: Minus (amount)
values.description: The lesser value expressed in amount.

values.name: Plus (percentage)
values.description: The greater value expressed in percentage.

values.name: Plus (amount)
values.description: The greater value expressed in amount.

values.name: Plus/minus (percentage)
values.description: The greater/lesser value expressed in percentage.

values.name: Plus/minus (amount)
values.description: The greater/lesser value expressed in amount.

values.name: No allowance
values.description: Code specifying that there is no allowance.

values.name: No charge
values.description: Code specifying that there is no charge.

values.name: Maximum
values.description: Highest possible value; maximum; not exceeding; up to.

values.name: Exact
values.description: Indicates that this is the exact amount.
